test_title: PYST 46: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 3rd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

BCD_B_DDBC_D_CDD
solution:
Given : BCD_B_DDBC_D_CDD

By checking options :

 
• BCBB → BCD__**B**__B__**C**__DDBC__**B**__D__**B**__CDD → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• DCDB → BCD**__D__**B__C__DDBC**__D__**D__B__CDD → (It follows the pattern of : BCDD - BCDD - BCDD - BCDD)
 
• CCDB → BCD**__C__**B__C__DDBC**__D__**D__B__CDD → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• CBDB → BCD**__C__**B**__B__**DDBC**__D__**D__B__CDD → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (2) gives the pattern of "BCD__D__ - B__C__DD - BC__D__D - __B__CDD"

Hence, **"DCDB"** is the correct answer.
